subject: Structured feedback rollout + confidential handoffs: timeline & manager playbooks
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Structured feedback rollout + confidential handoffs: timeline & manager playbooks

Team —

I sketched a pragmatic timeline and a very short manager playbook for the FY27 review window. Goal: keep the window tight (6 weeks max), give managers clear language for confidential handoffs, and reduce last-minute exceptions. Key asks below; attached are the initial draft playbook (PDF) and the timeline spreadsheet.

What I want from each of you by EOD Monday (23 Nov):
- Marcus: review the timeline and highlight any infrastructure/ops blackouts that conflict with review weeks.
- Monica: confirm the confidential routing for sensitive roles (legal & compliance touchpoints) and whether we should require in-person signoff for Level 4+ escalations.
- Laura: refine manager-facing language for 1:1 calibration and the exception request template.
- Priyom & Grace: quick pass on communication cadence and any asks from People Ops.

A couple of process notes captured in the draft playbook:
- Managers submit ratings and short factsheet (150–250 words) per direct report.
- Sensitive roles (security, infra lead, legal) will use the confidential-handoff flow: manager -> Monica (People Ops) -> Legal for an audit stamp before finalizing rating.
- Exceptions (comp/level changes, confidentiality flagged) require a two-person approval: manager + Monica; Level 5 exceptions escalate to me and Laura.

I appreciate quick eyes. If you're ok with the proposed 6-week window that begins Mon 12 Jan 2027, I'll publish the manager playbook and run a short (30m) optional briefing next week.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Head of Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-11-20_draft-manager-playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); FY27_review-timeline-candidate-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Structured feedback rollout + confidential handoffs: timeline & manager playbooks

Thanks — this looks good and concise. A few quick notes inline:

- Timeline: Jan 12 start is fine but can we nudge manager calibration to week 2 (so managers have 7 days after submissions for calibration)? That keeps the public-facing window tight but gives calibration breathing room.
- Manager playbook: I'll tighten the language around evidence ("3 data points + one development note") and add a short script for managers to use when delivering sensitive feedback.
- Confidential routing: Monica, I agree we should require an audit stamp for Level 4+ in security/compliance. Do we have an estimated turnaround time from Legal?

I can have an edited playbook back by Monday morning and will add two canned emails: manager -> direct and manager -> HR (confidential flag).

On publication: recommend a staged rollout — managers first (closed doc), then an all-engineering heads session, then an all-hands for general timeline (no ratings detail).

Laura
VP, People Operations

Agree with the flows. A few operational clarifications:

- Legal turnaround: for a standard audit stamp on a confidential handoff (Level 4), Legal is estimating 48–72 business hours. For Level 5 (comp/level changes), it becomes a 5 business day process because of compensation review.
- Evidence collection: People Ops will require a single consolidated PDF per direct (manager-submitted) stored in the secure HR drive (link in thread). I'll add a checklist to the spreadsheet so managers know required docs.
- Manager training: recommend one mandatory 45m calibration for managers of >6 direct reports; optional 20m refresh for smaller managers.

I will update the timeline spreadsheet with the Legal turnaround bullets and add the checklist.

—Monica

Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Structured feedback rollout + confidential handoffs: timeline & manager playbooks

Quick ops check —

I reviewed the initial timeline and ran it against planned infra migrations for Jan. Two conflicts:
1) Jan 14–16: cluster migration for EU infra (affects infra on-call rotation).
2) Jan 19: global deploy freeze for internal platform rollout.

Proposal: keep the public submission window 12–27 Jan but mark Jan 14–16 as a "soft blackout" that encourages non-critical sessions to avoid heavy synchronous meetings; move mandatory manager calibration to Jan 20–22 so it doesn't overlap with deploy freeze. That keeps a 6-week overall cadence without creating manager overload.

I also flagged a note in the spreadsheet about relying on team leads to cover calendar scheduling for managers with more than 8 directs.

Marcus
Director, Platform Engineering

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Structured feedback rollout + confidential handoffs: timeline & manager playbooks

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Final decisions:

1) Window: Submissions open Mon 11 Jan (shifted 1 day earlier) — public deliverables due Fri 22 Jan. Manager calibration: Mon 25 Jan – Thu 28 Jan.
2) Confidential routing: Level 4 -> People Ops -> Legal (48–72 business hours). Level 5 exceptions go to Nikhil + Laura + Legal for approval (5 business days).
3) Manager training: mandatory 45m for managers with >6 directs on Jan 6 (recorded). Optional 20m "refresher" on Jan 19 for everyone.
4) Communication cadence: Laura will publish closed manager docs by Mon 29 Nov, and we'll run a manager Q&A on Tue 30 Nov (30m). Public company timeline (no rating specifics) goes out Wed 1 Dec.

Next steps (owners):
- Laura: publish final manager playbook (by Mon 29 Nov) + canned templates.
- Monica: add Legal turnaround and checklist to spreadsheet (done).
- Marcus: flag calendar collisions to infra teams and confirm blackout language.
- Priyom: draft the Manager FAQs and escalation matrix; I'll review.

I'll run the manager briefing on Nov 30 at 10:00 PT (invite to follow). If any of you foresee a blocker for the dates above, speak up by EOD tomorrow.

Nikhil
Head of Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference
